required_performance_proof: Controlled authorized non-production concurrency with latency distribution including p50/p95/p99, error/5xx rate, effective throttling/saturation behavior, and business-integrity validation.

repo_native_load_harness.finding: No repository-native controlled-load harness or dedicated performance workflow was found that can safely satisfy the acceptance without external target/auth context.

authorized_nonprod_identity.finding: No authorized test tenant/user/API credential or safe authentication mechanism is available to this invocation for controlled concurrent write/read load.

approved_test_data_path.finding: No approved disposable test dataset/write-return path is available for integrity-preserving load.

load_runner.finding: No currently authorized runner capable of real concurrent HTTP load is available from the repository/runtime tools without introducing unapproved external execution.

render_tooling.finding: The Render connector exposes one workspace but no workspace is selected. Its service operations require explicit workspace confirmation before access; this non-interactive run cannot infer/select it. Even service metrics alone would not replace authorized load identity and a permitted load runner.

public_smoke.finding: Reachability or anonymous/read-only smoke cannot prove authenticated business concurrency, throttling, saturation or post-load integrity.

safety_decision.reason: Running load without an authorized DEV identity/tenant and controlled runner would violate the performance DoD and VAEP security/scope constraints.

verdict.barrier: Authorized non-production identity/test tenant plus approved controlled-load runner/data path are required to produce real performance evidence safely.
